messages.content:
Inspect this flowchart image against the requested process. Identify up to 4 specific mistakes: missing stages, wrong arrow direction or branch, overlapping boxes, unreadable text. Name the visible labels involved. Do not invent an error if the image is unclear. Return a short list of concrete corrections.

Requested process:
Create a readable directed flowchart for the following process. Use exactly the quoted stage labels. The first stage is a start node, the last is an end node, any explicitly named decision is a decision node, and all other stages are process nodes. Label decision branches exactly Yes and No. Do not add stages or connections. Follow this exact sequence: "Library intake begins" -> "Receive donated book" -> "Inspect book" -> "Assign catalogue number" -> "Attach shelf label" -> "Place book on shelf" -> "Library intake complete".

response.text:
1. Remove the "Library intake begins" box as it is redundant.
2. Correct the arrow direction from "Receive donated book" to "Inspect book".
3. Ensure all boxes are distinct and not overlapping.
4. Make sure the text in the "Library intake complete" box is clear and readable.

Visible labels involved: Library intake begins, Receive donated book, Inspect book, Assign catalogue number, Attach shelf label, Place book on shelf, Library intake complete.
